capabilities: Plan tasks and events in calendar views across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes
Track versioned habits, morning/evening routines and workout programs with confirmed snapshots
Compute workout and routine statistics per selected date and period
Organize records under configurable life areas
Download optional static illustrated headers per season and time of day
extras: Licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, so commercial use is restricted; it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; illustrated headers (WebP, 472 images) are downloaded separately from GitHub releases with their own image license; renaming from 'Life Planner' to 'Manifest' kept the plugin id life-planner.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for planning days and tracking habits, routines and workouts across calendar periods with shared records and statistics.

relations.evidence: Yandex is a configurable default, not a mandatory account

summary: Life planner that organizes daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes with tasks, habits, routines, workouts, life areas and period statistics.
